description: Start an agent on a trail. Fire the project's coding-agent trigger on the trail. While the trail has no approved plan, this fires a read-only **plan** run: it reads the trail, asks the person how it should ship (straight to main, behind a flag, flag and experiment, kill switch, flag and kill switch) and…

agent.description: Which coding agent to fire — `claude`, `cursor`, `copilot` or `jules`. Omitted, the project's coding-agent trigger.

connectorId.description: A specific trigger connector to fire. Overrides `agent`.

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

kind.description: Which run to fire. Omitted, the server picks — `plan` while the trail has no approved plan, else `build`. Asking for `build` before the plan is approved is refused with `409`, and so is asking for `plan` once one is approved: edit the plan, or fire `replan`. `replan` is allowed only once a plan is approved: a read-only run that re-reads the goal metric, the items' outcomes and project memory and submits the next revision, which waits as `drafted` for approval.

prompt.description: Extra instructions appended to the trail prompt.

name: trails_start
